_comment: Your own monsters (restart the server after editing; run install-custom-gear.cmd with the game closed so the game knows them too). Each copies an existing monster's look ('base') under a new id and name. level and health are its own; xp (the same for everyone sharing the kill, at any level) and gold set its kill reward; attack, defence and damage are the base's unless set. resists {"all": 400, "Poison": 300} and evasion {"all": 500} set its own (types: Pierce, Slash, Crush, Heat, Cold, Magic, Poison, Chaos; evasion: Physical, Spell, Movement, Wounding, Weakening, Mental). scale multiplies its size. abilities (bosses): kind weaponBuff (damage/damageType added to its auto-attacks for duration s, recast recastAfter s after it ends), selfHot (heal every s, recast when it ends), selfHeal (a castTime s heal, once below each atHealth percent; interruptedBy skill names stop it), aoeStun (every cooldown s: damage and a stunSeconds stun to everyone within radius m, unless evaded with evadedBy). name is what the game shows; look is the existing skill whose animation and icon it copies, under its own skillId (and effectId for its icon), new ids the client mod adds. Place one with a saved spawn (the GM .spawn command, or ask Claude).
